questions.q: Jatin invested Rs.27260 in buying Rs.100 shares of a company at Rs.116 each. If the company paid 16% dividend at the end of the year, find his income from the dividend.
questions.explain: Number of shares purchased by Jatin = $${27260} / {116}$$ = 235

questions.q: A person has deposited Rs.13200 in a bank which pays 14% interest. He withdraws the money and invests in Rs.100 stock at Rs.110 which pays a dividend of 15%. How much does he gain or lose.
questions.explain: Income from bank = 14% of Rs. 13200 = Rs. 1848.
